lifetime: current synchronous widget callback, current VM context and unique callback epoch
frames: tokens only; all reply frames revoked at callback exit including failure; no native FReply in persistent frames
inout: publish new reply token to inout and return slots; original token remains immutable
ownership: native FReply lives only in callback scope, no persistent snapshot, reflection storage/defaults or native containers
targets: constructed non-template live widget in callback world; weak targets revalidated at final publication
validation: handled reply required for commands; mouse position finite and int32 range before native cast; drag key mouse/touch only
outside_callback: frame creation and all reply operations rejected
failure: native parent fallback; partially built commands not published
pointer_provenance: DetectDragIfPressed accepts only current native input callback pointer token; stored snapshots are read-only values
